title: Artificial Intelligence: An Interdisciplinary Roundtable on the Pope's First Encyclical
where: Alumni Weekend, Information Commons, Loyola University Chicago
text: A faculty and alumni roundtable on Pope Leo XIV's first encyclical, Magnifica Humanitas. Co-moderated with Dr. George Thiruvathukal (Computer Science), with Dr. Theresa Burkhart (Healthcare Administration) on the panel. We dug into what AI can really do, who pays and who benefits, and how to teach it while keeping it human.
